description: Defines data models for smart home devices, device types, and dummy data for UI previews in a smart home app.

classes.name: SmartDevice
classes.description: Represents a smart home device with properties such as id, name, type, state, room, and optional camera ID.

classes.name: DeviceType
classes.description: Enumeration of smart device types including Light, Thermostat, Camera, Plug, Sensor.

classes.name: DummyData
classes.description: Singleton object providing sample smart device instances for UI development and testing.

methods.name: DummyData.devices
methods.description: A list of predefined SmartDevice instances serving as dummy data.
